    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    It takes 6 minutes for a soft-boiled egg with a runny yolk, 8 minutes for a jammy yolk, and 10 to 12 minutes for a fully hard-boiled egg, starting from large, cold eggs placed into already boiling water. 
    Cooking Times (Hot Water Method)
    • 6 minutes: Liquid, runny yolk and set whites (great for dipping).
    • 7 to 8 minutes: Thick, sticky, "jammy" yolk.
    • 10 to 12 minutes: Firm, classic hard-boiled egg without a chalky texture or gray ring. 
    You can find more detailed visual guides and variations at BBC Good Food. 
    Easy Step-by-Step Method
    1. Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil
      . Make sure there is enough water to completely cover the eggs.
    2. Use a slotted spoon to gently lower cold eggs straight from the refrigerator into the boiling water.
    3. Reduce the heat slightly to maintain a gentle boil and start your timer immediately.
    4. Prepare an ice water bath while the eggs cook.
    5. Transfer the eggs directly into the ice bath for at least 5 to 15 minutes to stop the cooking and make peeling easier. 
    Would you like to know tips on how to easily peel your boiled eggs, or do you need times for a specific egg size like medium or extra-large?

    People also ask
    Is 10 minutes long enough to hard boil an egg?
    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    Yes, 10 minutes is long enough to hard-boil a standard large egg if you place it into already boiling water. 
    Cooking Times in Boiling Water
    • 6 minutes: Liquid, runny yolk.
    • 8 minutes: Soft, jammy yolk.
    • 10 minutes: Classic hard-boiled egg with a firm white and a cooked, slightly soft or mashable center.
    • 12 minutes: Fully solid, firm hard-boiled yolk. 
    Tips for Success
    • Hot start: Lower cold eggs straight from the fridge into actively boiling water using a spoon to prevent cracking
      .
    • Ice bath: Transfer the cooked eggs immediately into a bowl of ice water for at least 10 to 15 minutes to stop the cooking and make them easier to peel.
